notes: County 'Election Information and Results' page (Umbraco /media/ files) posts, per election, an unofficial summary and an unofficial 'Precinct by Precinct' report, then official ones. No Clarity link. Every file's server Last-Modified is in August 2026 (for example Wed, 12 Aug 2026 15:38:28 GMT for the 2024 file; Mon, 10 Aug 2026 for the 2026 files), which reflects a later re-upload or site move, so the server gives no election-night upload evidence. The printed report times and PDF CreationDates of the unofficial precinct reports are all on election night: 2024 general 'Precinct Summary - 11/05/2024 9:55 PM' (scan CreationDate 2024-11-06 04:01 UTC); 2026 primary 'PRECINCT BY PRECINCT REPULICAN - 03/03/2026 10:08 PM' (CreationDate 2026-03-04 04:11 UTC); 2026 runoff 'UNOFFICIAL REPUBLICAN RESULTS - 05/26/2026 9:31 PM' (scan CreationDate 2026-05-27 02:47 UTC). Each election has a single unofficial precinct report. Results are END on printed run time only (low); check 3 could confirm the posting time. Scanned files read visually.
tag_rationale: All three elections are END (one unofficial precinct report with election-day votes, printed on election night), so the tag is PRECINCT_END_OF_NIGHT; confidence low because check 2 had printed run times but no election-night server upload times.
